problem: A baker has 24 eggs. She uses 6 to make a cake, then splits the rest equally into 3 cartons. How many eggs are in each carton?
Tom reads 15 pages on Monday and twice as many on Tuesday. How many pages did he read in total over the two days?
A tank holds 54 liters. It loses 12 liters, then a third of what remains is poured out. How many liters are poured out?
A store had 80 shirts. It sold 25, then received a shipment that doubled its current stock. How many shirts does it have now?
Sarah has $120. She spends a quarter of it on books, then $15 on lunch, then earns $40. How much money does she have now?
A classroom has 6 rows of 5 desks. 8 desks are removed, then the rest are split evenly between 2 teachers. How many desks does each teacher get?
A runner runs 4 km on day one, three times that on day two, and on day three half of the day-two distance. What is the total distance over the three days?
A farmer has 90 apples. He gives away a third, then packs the rest into bags of 6, then sells all but 2 of the bags. How many bags did he sell?

A company has 200 employees. 30% work remotely. Half of the remote workers are engineers. The company then hires 5 more remote engineers, after which 4 remote engineers leave. How many remote engineers are there now?

A library has 500 books. A fifth are fiction. Of the fiction, 40 are checked out and later 10 of those are returned to the shelf. Then a seventh of the fiction currently on the shelf is donated away. How many fiction books are on the shelf?
Mike earns $20 per hour. He works 8 hours on Monday and 6 hours on Tuesday. He is taxed 25% on his total earnings. How much does he take home?
A pizzeria makes 12 pizzas per hour for 5 hours. A quarter are sold immediately. Of those left, 20 are reserved. The rest are discarded. How many are discarded?

A school orders 8 boxes of 25 notebooks. A fifth are defective and removed. The good notebooks are split equally among 4 classes. Each class then gives 3 notebooks to the office. How many notebooks does each class keep?

A factory produces 1000 widgets. 10% fail inspection. The passing widgets are packed 9 per box. 5 boxes are damaged in shipping and discarded. Each remaining box sells for $20. What is the total revenue?

A charity raises $5000. 20% goes to admin. The rest is split equally among 4 projects. Each project spends a quarter of its funds on supplies. That supplies budget is then increased by $50. What is each project's final supplies budget?

A theater has 15 rows of 20 seats. A fifth of the seats are unsold. Of the sold seats, a quarter are balcony seats at $30 each. The theater then refunds 4 balcony tickets. What is the balcony revenue after refunds?

A warehouse has 12 pallets of 50 boxes. 10% of the boxes are damaged and removed. The rest are loaded equally onto 3 trucks. Each truck unloads 20 boxes at the first stop, then unloads half of its remaining boxes at the second stop. How many boxes are left on each truck?

A game starts you with 1000 points. You lose 20%. A bonus then doubles your points. A penalty removes 400. The result is split equally across 4 levels. Each level loses 50 points and then gains a 10-point streak bonus. How many points does each level have?
A bakery makes 24 dozen cookies. A quarter of them burn. The rest are boxed 6 per box. 6 boxes are sold. Of the boxes that remain, half are donated. How many boxes are donated?

A reservoir holds 8000 liters. A leak drains a quarter of it. Then 1000 liters are added. A fifth of the total is then used for irrigation. The remainder is split equally between 2 towns. Each town returns 200 liters. How much does each town keep?

Start with 64. Then, in order: subtract 14; divide by 2; multiply by 3; add 18; subtract 33; multiply by 2; subtract 20; divide by 4. What is the result?
Start with 100. Then, in order: add 20; subtract 5; multiply by 2; subtract 30; divide by 2; add 15; subtract 8; multiply by 3; subtract 21; divide by 3. What is the result?
Start with 81. Then, in order: subtract 9; divide by 2; add 14; multiply by 3; subtract 18; divide by 4; add 27; subtract 3; multiply by 2; subtract 10. What is the result?

Start with 73. Then, in order: add 48; subtract 17; multiply by 3; subtract 88; divide by 2; add 59; subtract 34; multiply by 2; subtract 19; divide by 5; add 66; subtract 29; multiply by 4; subtract 52. What is the result?

Start with 88. Then, in order: add 12; divide by 2; multiply by 3; subtract 15; add 35; divide by 5; multiply by 4; subtract 8; divide by 2; add 27; subtract 3; multiply by 6; subtract 42; divide by 3. What is the result?
